question: At a fixed 250 ms release boundary, how much additional application-observed key occupancy is caused by placing capture plus PNG encode/write/reopen before physical KeyRelease rather than after it?
independent_variable: ordering of the identical artifact pipeline relative to KeyRelease
primary_metric: paired pipeline_first-minus-release_first application-observed press-to-release duration in ms

decision.pipeline_material: median paired delta >= 10 ms OR p95 paired delta >= 20 ms
decision.pipeline_not_tens_ms: median paired delta < 10 ms AND p95 paired delta < 20 ms

scope: development mechanism isolation only; no ViZDoom/gameplay/model/planner claim
